sloka: ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः ।शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं महात्मनां राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् ।। ६.५९.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastu rāmasya niśamya vākyaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ śakrasamānavīryaḥ ।śaśaṁsa rāmasya balapravekaṁ mahātmanāṁ rākṣasapuṅgavānām ।। 6.59.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Vibheeshana, equal to Indra in valour, on hearing the great soul Rama, revealed about the Rakshasa army endowed with great strength.
